ai_summary: This document details Ashiana Housing Ltd.'s routine regulatory disclosure under SEBI Insider Trading Regulations, reporting an open market purchase of 5,826 equity shares by Mr. Deepak Dhyani, a Designated Person, for approximately INR 20 lakhs. This transaction, while potentially signaling internal confidence from a key personnel, represents a minor increase in his stake (to 0.00726%) and constitutes a standard compliance event. No red flags are identified, as it is a transparent, open market acquisition with no material impact on the company's overall ownership structure.
